description: This file contains shell functions and setup scripts for configuring GRE tunnel interfaces, including both IPv4 and IPv6 variants, in OpenWRT network configurations. It defines functions for setting up, tearing down, and initializing GRE tunnel interfaces with detailed options, as well as handling dependencies and network verification.

methods.name: gre_generic_setup
methods.description: Configures a generic GRE tunnel with specified parameters such as mode, local/remote addresses, and options like MTU, IPv6, TTL, and multicast.

methods.name: gre_setup
methods.description: Sets up a IPv4 GRE tunnel including resolving peer IP, dependency handling, and calling the generic setup.

methods.name: proto_gre_setup
methods.description: Wrapper function to initialize GRE IPv4 setup using 'greip' mode.

methods.name: proto_gretap_setup
methods.description: Sets up a GRE tap interface with associated network interfaces.

methods.name: gretap_generic_teardown
methods.description: Removes device dependencies associated with a GRE tap interface.

methods.name: proto_gre_teardown
methods.description: Placeholder for GRE interface teardown; implementation may be application-specific.

methods.name: proto_grev6_setup
methods.description: Sets up an IPv6 GRE tunnel.

methods.name: proto_grev6tap_setup
methods.description: Sets up an IPv6 GRE tap interface.

methods.name: grev6_setup
methods.description: Configures a generic IPv6 GRE tunnel.

methods.name: gretap_generic_teardown
methods.description: Removes dependencies for IPv6 GRE tap interfaces.

methods.name: proto_grev6tap_teardown
methods.description: Teardown for IPv6 GRE tap interfaces.

methods.name: proto_gre_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for IPv4 GRE interface.

methods.name: proto_grev6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for IPv6 GRE interface.

methods.name: proto_grev6tap_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for grev6 tap.
